verdict.rationale: Namecheap runs a live, separate sandbox API endpoint (api.sandbox.namecheap.com/xml.response) alongside the production endpoint (api.namecheap.com), and it answers API calls on its own server. That is first-party evidence of a distinct test environment. However, the pack shows only that the endpoint exists and responds. Nothing documents how sandbox accounts, data isolation from production, or non-charging behaviour for operations like Create/Renew work. missing for 10: documentation of sandbox account setup and data isolation from production, confirmation that charge-bearing calls are simulated in sandbox, SDK/Terraform sandbox toggles, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
